subject: Final textures regression + field addition
body: Final after audit fixes: helper 724 checks PASS release and ASan/UBSan; n2r v2 suite PASS both modes (incl format125/ETC2/depth16 positive with legacy refusal, sparse binding positions3/9, orphan refusal, mips/cube); existing n2r oracle PASS; ARM64 render/bridge/full compute_frontend compile PASS; freestanding helper has no undefined symbols. Required ABI addition: struct n2t_texture_layout now has uint32_t swizzle_valid immediately before swizzle_word; zero-init still means format default, valid RRRR requires swizzle_valid=1. Render/compute must build against current header. ETC2 RGB8/RGB8A1 now 8-byte blocks; cube ordinary exact6+square; pack requires nonzero backing address and length; first_layer/level view-relative documented; n2r preflight validates version/count/duplicates/orphans/kinds/layout spans/sampler; legacy format whitelist is bypassed only for authoritative sidecar bindings and identical legacy requests still refuse. Final lowerer table correction accepted: table1[N] texture/image, table2[N] sampler, internal sampler2[256]; ignore my earlier table3 sentence. Remaining cross-owner: render TeguTexture array/cube/3D/MS creation+fact extraction, bridge n2mb_draw_v2 transport, render legacy-sampler guard via tegu_sampler_legacy_word_ok, frontend exact-constructor harness. No phone/build/commit/publish.
